PLAYER TYPE

Mid-level players who want a light and easy-to-handle model with which to improve their shots and technique, especially in the attacking zone, is an option to consider.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The features we have in the WILSON OPTIX V2 POWER BLUE 2026 are typical of a top brand like Wilson. We are looking at a mid-range model, but with Premium finishes and very good playability.

To take into account its fiberglass composition, which gives us high ball output. In the core we find a foam rubber with a soft-intermediate touch, which guarantees total control and greater reactivity when we want to press the ball.

It has a smooth matte surface in a bluish-gray color, a quite beautiful and elegant tone.

products.title: Drop Shot Axion Attack 2.0 2026 - Drop Shot
products.description:
DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2.0 2026 - Jon Sanz's new padel racket for the 2026 season. An offensive racket, in teardrop format. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2.0 2026 is the official padel racket of Jon Sanz, developed together with the Navarrese player for the 2026 season. This padel racket offers everything that a professional padel racket can offer, which is a comfortable feel, versatile game and a Premium design.

PLAYER TYPE

This model is focused on high-level, competitive players looking to have a professional player's racket. Recommended above all to an offensive player rather than a defensive one.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The new DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2.0 2026 offers high power but with good control thanks to its teardrop format and medium-high balance, with the right and necessary sweet spot. Maintains a good level of control in long exchanges.

The Eva Pro High Density core provides a firm and stable feel, ideal for players looking for a solid response on impact and greater security in each shot.

The faces are made of 24K Twill Carbon, a light and reactive material that improves the ball's exit speed and provides a more defined feel when hitting.

Other technologies of this racket is the Ergo Pro Protector system, a protector already incorporated to protect the frame from the typical friction of this sport. In addition, we highlight the anti-vibration system incorporated into the bridge called the Anti Twist System.

products.title: Nexus Firefight - Nexus
products.description:
NEXUS FIREFIGHT - A teardrop-shaped carbon power racket. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL 

The NEXUS FIREFIGHT is a racket with which your game can shine due to its great power. With a great ball feel, this racket is perfect for all types of intermediate level players, being able to adapt to the conditions of the match at all times.

PLAYER TYPE 

Racquet specially designed for players looking to handle the blow without losing power in each of their blows. Intermediate level.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE 

This racket is characterized by its 3K carbon that provides durability and resistance. Its teardrop/diamond shape helps you have extra power with a more controlled game in the defensive phases of the game. 

Its smooth gloss finish makes its color stand out. Aesthetically it has a modern and striking design. Features a combination of glossy black with neon yellow and white details

PLAY STYLE

The NEXUS FIREFIGHT is designed for a balanced playstyle, albeit with a bias towards power.
